answer: Seed trust from a small hand-verified genesis set and let it flow outward like heat across a frozen tundra: each agent earns reward only in proportion to the trust-flow that actually reaches it along non-kin attestation edges, computed as a PageRank-style fixed point. A sybil ring can thread millions of fake links among its own masks, but trust entering the cluster is capped by its few real vouchers, so the per-epoch delta of earnable reward per fake collapses toward zero; attackers must buy genuine endorsements, not mint them.
